title: Scraper: Tyan (EPYC)
description:

Acceptance criteria:

Goal: Scraper for Tyan server motherboards. Smaller catalog than the big-four server vendors but historically interesting — Tyan ships some EPYC reference designs and unusual SKUs (Transport HX, Tomcat HX/SX) that surface different AGESA/PSP build configurations.

board_class: EPYC.

Sockets/board families:
- SP3: Tomcat HX S8030, Transport HX TN83-B8251, S8253 (Naples/Rome/Milan)
- SP5: S8050, Tomcat HX S8055 (Genoa)

Access strategy:
- Catalog: https://www.tyan.com/Motherboards_AMD_EPYC — lists all AMD EPYC server boards.
- Per-board: each model has a /Solutions/Motherboards/{MODEL}#download tab with BIOS history.
- No WAF observed historically, but verify before committing — if Cloudflare rolls out, plan for Wayback CDX fallback against download links served from Tyan's CDN.

Implementation notes:
- Smaller catalog (~10–15 active EPYC boards) means a hand-written list of model→download-URL mappings is acceptable as a starting point if the catalog HTML changes too often.
- Scope is small enough that this is a good first-issue for a contributor — well-bounded and self-contained.

Acceptance criteria:
- Class at src/psp_etl/scrape/tyan.py
- Tests with HTML fixtures for catalog + per-board pages
- ZIP extraction handles Tyan's typical layout (raw .BIN alongside flash utility)
- CLI registration

Related: #79, #81.
